title: syndred
description: Brings Magic and Technology in a harmonious way.
body:
![Syndred Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5b29dfe7a72112050a5a598302d2fb20d8e16747.png)
# What is this?

Syndred is a work in progress mod that brings a mix of Fantasy and Automation is your world. Like said, it's work in progres and we are not even at 2% of the automation side, but we got decorative elements, ores, mobs (moth & kindof sheep/cow you'll see), and more with loreful stuff.

# What to expect from Syndred?

Syndred will evolve in the next updates with a LOT of automation stuff, but not like Mekanism or Create, it will focus on magical technology, wireless machines and spirit power...

# We need Feedback!

Syndred is work in progress, and it would be an extreme pleasure to get your advices, opinions and feedback on the project. It could help us getting faster, implementing stuff you want. We really want to bring your vision of Syndred in our project.

# The Team
- Nekoniyah: MCreator Developer & Creator
- 4444gale: Texturer & Blockbench Artist

- Plant King Eli: Builder, Texturer & MCreator Developer
